name: SAP Business One: AI agent that looks up customers

options.systemMessage: You answer questions about customers in SAP Business One. Use the tool to look customers up by name. Answer only from what the tool returns.

parameters.toolDescription: Finds SAP Business One customers whose name contains a search text. Returns code, name, phone, e-mail, city and account balance of every matching customer.

condition.value: ={{ $fromAI('name', 'Part of the customer name to search for', 'string') }}

parameters.content:
## AI agent that looks up customers
The SAP Business One Service Layer node runs as a tool: the agent fills the name filter with `$fromAI()`, the tool returns every matching customer with six fields (Return All). A search text that matches many customers fills the agent's context quickly; turn Return All off and set a Limit if that happens. The tool can only read; keep the SAP user's permissions narrow anyway.

Select an OpenAI credential (or replace the chat model) and your Service Layer credential, then open the chat and ask, for example:

> Which customers have "Star" in their name, and what is their balance?
